definition: Unique identifier for the analyst-management Q&A exchange.

definition: SHA-256 identifier of the source transcript/document.

definition: Bank associated with the exchange.

definition: Reporting period associated with the exchange.

definition: Audience classification associated with the exchange.
format: Actual WS1 audience label, e.g. equity. all is a configuration option, not a record value.

definition: Analyst associated with the question in the exchange.
missing_rule: Never missing or blank; checked before export.

definition: Upstream BERTopic question label, optionally curated in Jamie and Eion — WS1 signals. No new topic fit.
source: Jamie and Eion — WS1 BERTopic/curated signal label; mapped into WS2 without refitting.
missing_rule: Blank when unavailable; missing values are not zero. Also withheld when regeneration against corrected WS1 text is unconfirmed.

definition: Semantic similarity/alignment between the analyst question and management answer.
format: cosine score [-1,1]; missing when embeddings unavailable
missing_rule: Blank when unavailable; missing values are not zero.

definition: Deterministic score representing how directly the answer addresses the question. Weights: semantic .45, topic .25, metric .15, number .10, time .05. Unavailable/non-applicable terms omitted. If WS1 topics are unconfirmed, omit their component and renormalize the available Mayami weights.
format: score [0,1]; available weights renormalised; not a probability
missing_rule: Blank when unavailable; missing values are not zero.

definition: Available weighting associated with the deterministic directness calculation.
missing_rule: Blank when unavailable; missing values are not zero.

definition: Deterministic measure of answer specificity.
format: score [0,1]; .40 numbers(cap4)+.35 metric tags(cap4)+.25 time mentions(cap2)
missing_rule: Blank when unavailable; missing values are not zero.

definition: Whether structured LLM analysis for the exchange completed successfully.
format: ok / failed / too_long / not_selected / disabled / ineligible
missing_rule: Never missing.

definition: Reason a model record was not accepted; blank when successful
missing_rule: Blank when unavailable; missing values are not zero.

definition: Model repository used for the new assessment For unprocessed/disabled rows this is configuration metadata, not evidence of inference.

definition: Short LLM explanation supporting the structured classifications.

definition: Hybrid signal combining deterministic and LLM-derived evidence of question-answer dissonance. .5*(1-directness)+.5*incompleteness; Complete=0, Partial=.5, Unanswered=1.
format: score [0,1], not probability; blank for failed/unprocessed/Unclear
missing_rule: Blank for failed, unprocessed, ineligible, disabled, Unclear completeness, or missing directness.

definition: Absolute difference between deterministic directness and mapped completeness; missing unless the assessment and both values are available.
format: score [0,1]; Complete=1, Partial=.5, Unanswered=0; not a probability
missing_rule: Blank when unavailable; missing values are not zero.

definition: Review queue category. Unassessed means no accepted model assessment; routine is not an accuracy guarantee.

definition: Full-answer lexical number screening versus LLM numeric-evidence flag. Pass means no lexical mismatch, not verified financial evidence or correct classification.
